mentions.name: backlog.fyi
mentions.description: A personal task manager with a weekly planning session so tasks aren't forgotten, and effortless task capture via forwarded emails or Telegram messages. It is privacy-respecting, fully open source, and self-hostable, with no ads, trackers, or subscriptions.
mentions.problem: Simple tools (Microsoft To Do, Google Tasks, text files, Post-it notes) were too basic and easy to forget about, while sophisticated task apps were overkill, asked for too many permissions, and generated noisy notifications.
mentions.audience: A personal task manager built for the author's own day-to-day use.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on https://backlog.fyi, a personal task manager, for the last few months.
